entities.name: Karel Nováček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karel Nováček is a retired Czech former top ten tennis player born in Prostějov, Czechoslovakia. In his career, Nováček won 13 singles titles and six doubles titles. His highest singles ranking was World No. 8, which he achieved on 18 November 1991.
